trends.name: Iran Escalation & Oil Price Risk
trends.summary: Trump's Tuesday deadline for Iran to reopen Strait of Hormuz faces pessimistic negotiations, with U.S. poised to target Iranian bridges and power plants. Negotiators expect deal failure, potentially triggering fresh escalation. Oil prices climbing toward $200 amid geopolitical risk, with PIMCO warning supply shocks could become growth shocks for the economy.

trends.name: AI Chip Boom & Semiconductor Deals
trends.summary: Samsung shares surge on 8-fold profit jump driven by AI chip demand. Broadcom secures expanded deals with Google and Anthropic, signaling sustained AI infrastructure investment. Anthropic raising $200M in private-equity venture, indicating AI capital intensity remains core growth driver.

trends.name: Health Insurance Sector Strength
trends.summary: Health insurers soaring after securing better-than-expected Medicare Advantage rates for 2027. Trump administration finalized favorable payment terms, reducing pressure on margins. Sector stocks rallying on improved visibility into profitability and reduced regulatory headwinds.

trends.name: Retail Investor Capitulation & Equities Weakness
trends.summary: Retail investors selling stocks at alarming pace, skipping dips and selling into rallies—signaling sentiment deterioration. Household survey shows 1.4M job losses YTD. Market bottom tied to interest rate clarity rather than geopolitical headlines, per J.P. Morgan and Cramer analysis.

trends.name: Universal Music $64B Takeover Proposal
trends.summary: Pershing Square's $64 billion takeover proposal drives Universal Music stock up 13%, signaling activist confidence in value unlock. Major M&A catalyst in music/entertainment sector with significant capital deployment implications.

trends.name: AI-Driven Commerce & Shopify Upgrade
trends.summary: Shopify receives double rating upgrade as AI-driven commerce becomes next leg of growth beyond valuation multiples. Platform leveraging agentic AI to reinvigorate legacy hardware and e-commerce ecosystems, unlocking margin expansion opportunities.

trends.name: Interest Rates & Inflation Swap Signals
trends.summary: 1-year inflation swaps trading at 3.24%, signaling elevated inflation expectations. Higher oil prices complicating rate outlook and economic growth trajectory. Credit market liquidity and macro outlook increasingly tied to Fed's inflation response and geopolitical oil shocks.

trends.name: Oracle AI Layoffs & AI Productivity
trends.summary: Oracle layoffs represent fulfillment of AI productivity promises, reducing headcount while maintaining output. Market interpreting as validation of AI ROI thesis, with buy-the-dip opportunity as stock absorbs workforce reduction. Signals broader AI-driven efficiency cycle in enterprise software.

trends.name: Renewable Energy & AI Power Demand
trends.summary: Renewable energy companies courting strategic buyers to unlock AI-driven power demand windfall. Data center and AI infrastructure buildout creating multi-year revenue visibility for clean energy providers. Sector positioning as essential infrastructure for AI economy.

trends.name: Commercial Real Estate & Rate Sensitivity
trends.summary: Expedia margin expansion supports re-entry opportunity as travel/hospitality rebounds. TJX retail competition intensifying on pricing amid consumer pressure. Sectors sensitive to rate environment facing margin compression, but selective reopening opportunities emerging as rates stabilize.

trends.name: AI Security Cybersecurity Theme
trends.summary: 'AI Security' emerging as next major cybersecurity investment theme as enterprises protect agentic AI systems. Regulatory and operational complexity of AI systems driving new security product demand and expanding addressable market for cyber vendors.

trends.name: Consumer Household Formation Collapse
trends.summary: Only 12% of Americans married with home ownership by age 30 in 2025, down from 52% in 1960. Structural decline in household formation driven by affordability crisis and student debt, with profound implications for housing demand, mortgage credit, and consumer spending cycles.
